product.olivetti-pcs6120.summary: The 75 MHz multimedia PCS 61xx in the Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-pcs6120.history: In March 1996, Computerwoche reported Olivetti’s PCS 61xx range for home multimedia.
product.olivetti-pcs6120.architecture: The case determines how many cards can be installed. The Tin Box riser has 2 ISA, 2 PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-pcs6120.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs6120.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs6120.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 16
product.olivetti-pcs6120.computerwoche-1: Computerwoche, Olivetti baut Modulo-, Suprema- und Systema-PC-Serien aus, 15 March 1996
product.olivetti-pcs6120.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.21.
